lingnan.decision: Keep FT/PT IDs, add the explicit opening and separate application fee, retain qualitative academic and alternative-language review. Do not multiply the programme fee by two part-time years, map Weekend to part-time or invent a new-scale TOEFL cutoff.

january.caveat: Generic Now Open promotion does not override an already passed category deadline

september.scheduleScope: Central taught-postgraduate September 2027 schedule; MPPM is not among its listed exceptions. Programme-specific earlier closure/capacity remains possible.

eduhk.academic: Recognised bachelor degree or accepted equivalent; field whitelist/any-discipline policy and numeric admission GPA are not established

english.other: GCSE/GCE OL English grade C or accepted equivalent
english.januaryValidityExample: Programme's 2026/27 example says tests on/after 1 January 2024
english.septemberValidityExample: Central 2027/28 example says tests on/after 1 January 2025
english.decision: Keep distinct published academic-year examples and confirm intake applicability manually; do not apply one programme-level minimum to both intakes or roll expiry from today

eduhk.documents: Institutional recognition/equivalence, applicable qualification assessment, official/confidential transcripts, translations and conditional Mainland-qualification verification need manual review; only shortlisted applicants undergo verification/interview and no admission is guaranteed
eduhk.delivery: In-person default; electives and specialisation quotas may change; an optional thesis does not turn the coursework programme into a research master
eduhk.decision: Refresh the January context with actual new source reading and fingerprint, without altering its four published fee values or category cutoffs. Append a separately bound September context with its own fees and central three-cutoff schedule. Raw category-dependent default prices/deadlines are null; no applicant status is inferred.
